48.0.en: A sudden [[influx:influx]] of young renters nearby did not [[imply:imply]] that the street had become [[affluent:affluent]].
48.0.zh: 附近一下子涌进许多年轻租客，这并不说明这条街已经富了起来。

48.1.en: He wanted to [[enrich:enrich]] the morning meals on offer, but he did not have [[sufficient:sufficient]] room for new shelves.
48.1.zh: 他想把早餐的花样添多一些，却没有足够的地方摆新货架。

48.2.en: The back room was barely [[adequate:adequate]], and he had no [[spare:spare]] chairs for resting guests.
48.2.zh: 后屋勉强够用，也没有多余的椅子给歇脚的客人坐。

48.3.en: His small [[saving:savings]] kept the lights on, while old boxes became [[redundant:redundant]] in the corner.
48.3.zh: 微薄的存款勉强维持着灯火，旧箱子在角落里成了多余的东西。

48.4.en: The [[lack:lack]] of help exhausted him, until a small [[company:company]] next door offered extra hands.
48.4.zh: 缺人手让他筋疲力尽，直到隔壁一家小公司伸来了援手。

48.5.en: That small [[enterprise:enterprise]] sent a friendly [[agent:agent]] to talk about shared morning deliveries.
48.5.zh: 那家小企业派来一位和气的经办人，商谈两家的早晨搭伙送货。

49.0.en: He ran the shop as a small business [[entity:entity]], and he feared to [[invest:invest]] more money without clear family support.
49.0.zh: 他把小店当成一个独立的小门面来经营，没有家里人明确撑腰，他不敢再多投钱。

49.1.en: With honest [[input:input]] from neighbors, he picked each [[product:product]] for the morning [[shelf:shelf]].
49.1.zh: 听了邻居们实在的意见，他认真挑好早晨货架上的每一件货。

49.2.en: A risky [[acquisition:acquisition]] of cheap winter [[goods:goods]] filled the back room to the roof.
49.2.zh: 一次冒险收购的便宜冬货，把后屋一直堆到了屋顶。

49.3.en: When the winter [[cargo:cargo]] arrived late, he forgot to [[insure:insure]] the [[fragile:fragile]] boxes inside.
49.3.zh: 冬天的货物到晚了，他忘了给里面那些易碎的箱子保价。

49.4.en: The driver gave a strong [[guarantee:guarantee]] that the next driver would be more [[reliable:reliable]] and calm.
49.4.zh: 司机再三保证，下一趟一定派个更可靠沉稳的人来。

49.5.en: Long [[negotiation:negotiations]] followed, and Lin asked his godson to [[attend:attend]] every evening talk.
49.5.zh: 接下来是一轮轮漫长的商谈，老林让教子每晚都来旁听。

50.0.en: No one was [[absent:absent]] from the table when they fixed the final [[sale:sale]] price for rice.
50.0.zh: 敲定大米最终售价那晚，桌边一个人也没有缺席。

50.1.en: They argued about [[wholesale:wholesale]] cost and joked about offering beans by [[auction:auction]] at [[dawn:dawn]].
50.1.zh: 他们为批发成本争得面红耳赤，又打趣说天一亮就把豆子摆出来拍卖。

50.2.en: The supplier made a low [[bid:bid]], and Lin shook hands on the final [[deal:deal]] with hope.
50.2.zh: 供货商报出了一个低价，老林满怀希望地握手成交。

50.3.en: Every [[transaction:transaction]] was written down, and regular [[turnover:turnover]] was counted on Sundays.
50.3.zh: 每一笔交易都记下来，每逢星期天就定期结算一次营业额。

50.4.en: They promised never to [[dump:dump]] rotten food and never to [[export:export]] problems to other streets.
50.4.zh: 他们保证绝不倾倒坏掉的食物，也绝不把麻烦推给别的街。

50.5.en: They would [[import:import]] fresh [[fruit:fruit]] weekly within the agreed [[quota:quota]] and share the danger together.
50.5.zh: 他们约定每周在谈好的限额内进口新鲜水果，有了风险一起担。

51.0.en: No bank [[interest:interest]] was involved, and no [[dividend:dividend]] for the whole year was promised to anyone.
51.0.zh: 这里头不牵涉银行利息，也没答应给谁一整年的分红。

51.1.en: Lin listed the remaining [[stock:stock]] in a notebook and opened a simple [[account:account]] book for daily records.
51.1.zh: 老林把剩下的存货记进本子，又开了一本简单的账簿记日常流水。

51.2.en: He left a small [[deposit:deposit]] [[first:first]], and agreed to clear the rest by regular [[installment:installments]].
51.2.zh: 他先交了一小笔定金，余下的说好按期分期付清。

51.3.en: He counted every [[shilling:shilling]] carefully and polished the old [[copper:copper]] jars for decoration.
51.3.zh: 他一枚一先令地数得清清楚楚，又把旧铜罐擦得亮亮的当摆设。

51.4.en: The landlord said the old [[estate:estate]] along the road would soon [[possess:possess]] a row of bright new shops.
51.4.zh: 房东说，沿路那片老地界很快就会有一排亮堂堂的新店铺。

51.5.en: Lin hoped the shop would become a family [[legacy:legacy]], and that peace would [[descend:descend]] on it for years.
51.5.zh: 老林盼着这间小店能成为传家的基业，愿安宁一年年落在这片屋檐上。

52.0.en: He felt the hard effort was [[worthy:worthy]] of the street he lived on, and every neighbor seemed [[valuable:valuable]] like bright gold.
52.0.zh: 他觉得这份辛苦对得起自己住的这条街，每个邻居都像亮闪闪的金子一样可贵。

52.1.en: A small profit [[incentive:incentive]] made him want to [[accelerate:accelerate]] the morning trade and open an hour earlier.
52.1.zh: 一点小赚头让他来了劲头，想把早市的生意加快节奏，提前一个钟头开门。

52.2.en: His [[prompt:prompt]] [[service:service]] pleased everyone on the street, and he set coins aside each week for staff [[salary:salaries]].
52.2.zh: 他待客利索，街上人人满意；每周他还攒下些硬币，给店员发工钱。

52.3.en: Thin [[income:income]] still covered soup and the daily [[wage:wages]] of the young helper boy.
52.3.zh: 微薄的进项还够喝口汤，也够付那个小帮工的日工资。

52.4.en: A late [[payment:payment]] from a [[restaurant:restaurant]] left him short, so he asked the supplier for a small [[refund:refund]].
52.4.zh: 一家饭馆迟迟没付货款，他手头紧了，只好向供货商要了一点退款。

52.5.en: He would [[reimburse:reimburse]] bus fares quickly but kept the [[paper:paper]] [[payroll:payroll]] locked in a drawer.
52.5.zh: 车费他总是很快报销，工资单却锁在抽屉里。

53.0.en: No extra [[remuneration:remuneration]] was offered, but a street [[subsidy:subsidy]] helped cover winter lights.
53.0.zh: 没有额外的报酬，但一笔街道补贴帮他付了冬天的电灯费。

53.1.en: He hoped to [[earn:earn]] trust slowly and treat the shop as a lifetime [[undertaking:undertaking]] with pride.
53.1.zh: 他想慢慢挣得大家的信任，把小店当作一辈子的事业来珍视。

53.2.en: Shopkeeping was no [[profession:profession]], he said, yet it was an honest [[occupation:occupation]] for his whole family.
53.2.zh: 他说，开小店算不上什么专业行当，却是一门养活全家的正经职业。

53.3.en: He [[saw:saw]] it as a true [[vocation:vocation]] and gave honest [[labour:labour]] from [[dawn:dawn]] to late [[night:night]].
53.3.zh: 他把这当成真正的天职，从清晨干到深夜，出的都是实在力气。

53.4.en: His tiny [[workforce:workforce]] of three helpers called him a [[gentle:gentle]] [[workaholic:workaholic]] with a smile.
53.4.zh: 他那三个帮工组成的小队伍，都笑称他是个温和的工作狂。

53.5.en: All shop [[personnel:personnel]] were kind, and the young [[clerk:clerk]] remembered every child by name.
53.5.zh: 店里的员工个个和气，年轻的店员记得每个孩子的名字。

54.0.en: During each [[interview:interview]], he read the handwritten [[resume:resumes]] slowly over hot tea.
54.0.zh: 每次面谈，他都就着热茶，慢慢读那些手写的简历。

54.1.en: Neighbors would [[recommend:recommend]] honest youths, and he would gladly [[employ:employ]] one more helper.
54.1.zh: 邻居们推荐老实本分的年轻人，他总是乐意再多雇一个帮手。

54.2.en: He promised never to [[hire:hire]] a man in anger, nor to [[fire:fire]] anyone on a rainy day.
54.2.zh: 他答应过，绝不在气头上雇人，也绝不在雨天辞退人。

54.3.en: No sudden [[layoff:layoffs]] frightened the helpers, and he would never [[dismiss:dismiss]] a sick boy.
54.3.zh: 从来没有突然的裁员吓到帮工们，他也从不赶走生病的孩子。

54.4.en: He would [[discharge:discharge]] nothing but shattered boxes, and never forced anyone to [[resign:resign]] in shame.
54.4.zh: 他清出去的只有摔碎的箱子，从不逼着谁羞着脸辞职。

54.5.en: He never used the [[flour:flour]] [[sack:sacks]] as chairs, and joked that he would never [[retire:retire]] early.
54.5.zh: 他从不拿面粉袋当椅子坐，还笑说自己绝不会提前退休。

55.0.en: One delivery [[failure:failure]] felt like the [[abortion:abortion]] of every plan he had made that morning.
55.0.zh: 一次送货失败，就像把他一早晨定下的盘算全数夭折了。

55.1.en: The sudden [[loss:loss]] of fresh milk gave an opponent an [[opportunity:opportunity]] to spread harsh rumors.
55.1.zh: 鲜奶突然断了货，倒给了对头一个散布难听话的机会。

55.2.en: Lin had little [[chance:chance]] to explain himself, and had to [[choose:choose]] between silence and angry shouts.
55.2.zh: 老林没什么机会为自己辩解，只能在沉默和大嗓门的呵斥之间选一样。

55.3.en: He wanted to [[solve:solve]] the issue calmly and keep a [[sustainable:sustainable]] link with the supplier.
55.3.zh: 他想心平气和地解决问题，保住和供货商的长久往来。

55.4.en: He tried to [[manage:manage]] his mood and [[regulate:regulate]] his breathing while he listened to the harsh complaints.
55.4.zh: 他一边听着刺耳的抱怨，一边稳住自己的情绪，也稳住自己的呼吸。

55.5.en: No [[sanction:sanction]] from the street committee could stop the shouting, so friends tried to [[coordinate:coordinate]] a calm talk.
55.5.zh: 街道委员会的处分也拦不住吵嚷，朋友们只好出面张罗一场心平气和的谈话。

56.0.en: Both sides agreed to [[cooperate:cooperate]] for one evening and [[collaborate:collaborate]] on checking the books.
56.0.zh: 双方答应合作一个晚上，一起对账查本子。

56.1.en: A young student explained [[legal:legal]] words and read the cold [[regulation:regulations]] aloud twice.
56.1.zh: 一位年轻学生讲解法律字眼，把那几条冷冰冰的条例读了两遍。

56.2.en: Their old [[treaty:treaty]] felt weak compared to the signed [[paper:paper]] [[agreement:agreement]] in Lin's hands.
56.2.zh: 他们那份口头旧约显得松散，比不上老林手里签了字的纸面协议。

56.3.en: The shop [[charter:charter]] on the wall differed from the delivery [[protocol:protocol]] kept by the driver.
56.3.zh: 墙上贴的店规，和司机手里那份送货规程对不上。

56.4.en: Late delivery broke the trade [[norm:norm]] and fell below the cold [[benchmark:benchmark]] they had set.
56.4.zh: 送货迟到破了行规，也跌破了他们定下的硬基准。

56.5.en: Clear [[criteria:criteria]] for fresh milk were missing, and no uniform [[standard:standard]] was ever written.
56.5.zh: 鲜奶怎样才算合格，从没有写清楚的标准；统一的标准更是从来没定过。

57.0.en: The driver held no written [[permit:permit]] for the night road, and his [[first:first]] words were a grudging [[admission:admission]] of the [[delay:delay]].
57.0.zh: 司机手里没有夜里行路的书面许可证，他开口的第一句话，就是勉强承认自己来晚了。

57.1.en: Lin said they must [[perform:perform]] every promise they had made and [[enforce:enforce]] the morning delivery times strictly.
57.1.zh: 老林说，许下的诺言句句都要履行，早晨的送货时间也必须严格执行。

57.2.en: He would [[reject:reject]] every rotten bottle, always, even under the [[tight:tight]] time [[constraint:constraints]] of [[dawn:dawn]].
57.2.zh: 哪怕黎明时分时间再紧，烂掉的瓶子他也照旧一律拒收。

57.3.en: An [[official:official]] from the street [[office:office]] called morning delivery [[mandatory:mandatory]] for all food shops.
57.3.zh: 街道办公室的一位官员说，清晨送货是所有食品店必须遵守的规定。

57.4.en: Strong tea gave a [[potent:potent]] boost, and both men felt [[bound:bound]] by honor to talk peacefully.
57.4.zh: 浓茶提神劲儿很足，两个人都觉得有道义在身，必须心平气和地谈。

57.5.en: Lin explained the plain [[obligation:obligation]] he felt toward the children, and he feared any road to [[court:court]].
57.5.zh: 老林说了自己对孩子们那份实实在在的义务，也说怕有一天走上法庭。

58.0.en: No [[supreme:supreme]] court was needed; the street [[office:office]] would [[enact:enact]] its own simple rules for sharing.
58.0.zh: 不必惊动最高法院，街道办公室自会制定几条简单的共用规矩。

58.1.en: They did not want to [[legislate:legislate]] harsh orders but keep [[rough:rough]] [[equity:equity]] between small shops.
58.1.zh: 他们不想立法立出苛刻的条令，只求小店之间保个大致的公平。

58.2.en: Old [[prejudice:prejudice]] against newcomers faded, and no [[discrimination:discrimination]] poisoned the evening talk.
58.2.zh: 对新来者的旧偏见散去了，那晚的谈话里没有一丝歧视的毒。

58.3.en: Lin refused to [[accuse:accuse]] anyone in anger and promised never to [[sue:sue]] over one late [[truck:truck]].
58.3.zh: 老林不肯在气头上指责任何人，也答应绝不为了一辆晚到的卡车去起诉谁。

58.4.en: No one wished to [[prosecute:prosecute]] the tired driver, nor to [[condemn:condemn]] his honest family.
58.4.zh: 没有人想起诉那个疲惫的司机，也不忍谴责他老老实实的一家人。

58.5.en: They dropped talk of [[boycott:boycott]] and opened a [[quiet:quiet]] evening [[session:session]] with hot tea.
58.5.zh: 抵制的话不提了，大家喝着热茶，开了个安安静静的晚间会议。

58.6.en: Our street now has a new [[surveillance:surveillance]] camera above the gate.
58.6.zh: 我们这条街的大门上方，现在装了一个新的监控摄像头。

58.7.en: No one accepted the [[supremacy:supremacy]] of one old family over the rest.
58.7.zh: 没有人接受一个老牌家族凌驾于众人之上的至上地位。

58.8.en: The rich guest smiled with a cold air of [[superiority:superiority]].
58.8.zh: 那位有钱的客人微微一笑，却带着一股冷冰冰的优越感。

58.9.en: One loud fight at the market gave the corner sudden [[notoriety:notoriety]].
58.9.zh: 市场上一场大吵大闹，让这个街角突然出了恶名。

58.10.en: The whole town agreed on fairer [[governance:governance]] under shared rules.
58.10.zh: 全城人都赞同，在共同遵守的规则下实行更公平的治理。

58.11.en: The tired shop owner swept the [[footpath:footpath]] clean before the first bus.
58.11.zh: 第一班公交车来之前，疲惫的店主已经把门前小路扫得干干净净。

59.0.en: Aunt Mei came to [[mediate:mediate]] gently and heard each tired [[plea:plea]] with calm eyes.
59.0.zh: 梅姨赶来温和地调解，用平静的眼神听完每一句疲惫的恳求。

59.1.en: Lin made a soft [[appeal:appeal]] for trust but did not [[contradict:contradict]] the driver harshly.
59.1.zh: 老林温言恳请大家信任，却没有生硬地反驳司机。

59.2.en: She tried to [[persuade:persuade]] both sides and cool the [[bitter:bitter]] [[controversy:controversy]] over spoiled milk.
59.2.zh: 她尽力劝说双方，给变质牛奶引起的那场激烈争论降降温。

59.3.en: A nervous [[whisper:whisper]] ran through the room as the driver began to [[mutter:mutter]] his apology.
59.3.zh: 屋里一阵紧张的耳语掠过，司机则开始嘟嘟囔囔地道起歉来。

59.4.en: A soft [[murmur:murmur]] of understanding spread, and even the angry uncles stayed [[mute:mute]] and calm.
59.4.zh: 会意的低语轻轻传开，连那些发火的叔伯也沉默下来，平静了。

59.5.en: They agreed to [[investigate:investigate]] the late [[truck:truck]] and to ask every [[witness:witness]] on the road for the truth.
59.5.zh: 他们商量好要调查那辆晚到的卡车，路上有谁看见了，就请谁说出实情。

paraZh.48: 年轻租客涌入并未让街变富，缺人手时隔壁小企业派人来搭伙。
paraZh.49: 他谨慎经营不敢多投，冬货迟到忘保价，请教子旁听漫长商谈。
paraZh.50: 定价之夜无人缺席，报低价成交，笔笔记账，限额进货共担风险。
paraZh.51: 不计利息分红，交定金分期付清，盼小店成为传家基业。
paraZh.52: 苦吃得值、邻居如金，提前开门赶早市，工钱退款样样操心。
paraZh.53: 街道补贴帮付冬灯费，他把小店当天职，小队伍笑他温和的工作狂。
paraZh.54: 就着热茶看简历，只收老实帮手，绝不气头上雇人、雨天辞人。
paraZh.55: 断货泡汤引谣言，他稳住情绪，朋友们张罗一场心平气和的谈话。
paraZh.56: 双方合作对账，学生讲解条例，口头旧约不如纸约，标准一直缺席。
paraZh.57: 司机认了迟到，老林死守早送时间，浓茶陪谈，只怕走上法庭。
paraZh.58: 不上法庭，街道自定共用规矩，放下抵制喝茶开会，街角装上监控。
paraZh.59: 梅姨温和调解劝和，司机嘟囔道歉，众人约定查车寻证人。
